mediaWork.title: Anatomy of Injustice: A Murder Case Gone Wrong
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Detailed examination of a single wrongful conviction case, racial bias in the justice system, death penalty issues
mediaWork.summaryNotes: An in-depth examination of Edward Lee Elmore's wrongful conviction for murder, highlighting systemic issues like racial bias, prosecutorial misconduct, inadequate defense, and flaws in the death penalty appeals process.  The book details Elmore's nearly 30 years on death row and his eventual release in 2012. It's presented as a compelling narrative that educates readers about systemic injustices while telling a powerful human story and received significant critical acclaim.
